about: One record per summer, 2008-2026. Areas in m2. Every value says what kind it is. 'calc_run1' is a first satellite count that is NOT validated (known errors); it is hidden by default on the page. Updated 2026-11-23: AINEVA areas 2008, 2009, 2011 and 2010 details (s2, full article); Betti & Fleck 2021 (s9).

events.text: First covers on the Presena glacier (and on the Diavolezza ski run).
Programme approved by the Province of Trento, with an agreement between the Province and Carosello-Tonale spa and agreements with the Universities of Milan and Trento.

years.documented_note: Laid at the start of summer along the ski-lift line and the central sector ('knee'). AINEVA Fig. 1 maps the covers 2008-2011.

Cover laid at the end of June, removed in early September; extended to large sectors above and below the 'knee'. Point measurement 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010: albedo 0.64 on the fleece vs 0.43 on the unmodified glacier; about 59 vs 123 cm w.e. of melt from radiation alone, i.e. about 52% less ablation (one station on each surface).

events.text: Unmodified glacier at 2,900 m: -2.93 m w.e. of ablation from 1 Oct 2009 to 27 Sep 2010 (energy balance, AWS installed by the Province). Bare ice exposed at the station from 16 Jul to 9 Sep.
Step between covered and uncovered surface observed at the end of summer: about 1.5-2 m. Extrapolating 52% to the whole season gives about 1.50 m w.e. kept (authors' calculation).
Fabric: TOPTEX GLS 340, made in Linz, Austria.
Materials test at about 2,765 m: up to 69% less melt.

years.note: Sentinel-2 starts (June 2015). Late-summer scenes exist; not yet counted.

years.calc_note: Training year of the classifier: the most favourable case.

events.text: Used sheets shown at the Venice Architecture Biennale, according to the operator.
Sheets suspended in the Italian Pavilion as 'The Invisible Mountain' (17th Architecture Biennale), by the authors of the article.

years.calc_flag: Anomalous: larger than any claimed year. Likely cloud or snow counted as fleece. To check by eye.
Anomalous: scene error or real change. To check by eye.

calc_run1_about: Random forest on Sentinel-2 L1C, trained on 2021-08-14 (fleece, ice, shadow); sunlit debris had no class; area of interest 1.51 km2. Run on 2026-11-04. Not validated.

sources_added.s9: Betti, G. & Fleck, K. (2021) 'The invisible mountain / La montagna invisibile', 6-page bilingual article, PDF dated 29 Sep 2021 (file 323-Articolo-631-1-10-20210929.pdf). Venue still to identify. Reported figures only.

items.text: Sheets of high-tenacity polypropylene, UV-stabilised, 340 g/m2.
34 tonnes of plastic cover the mountain every year.
17 tonnes go every year as special waste to the Bolzano incinerator (electricity and district heating).
A sheet is used two summers (turned over the second year), then replaced.
Reflects 78% of solar radiation up to 500 nm.

material_reported.check_calculated: 34,000 kg / 0.340 kg/m2 = 100,000 m2 of fabric: consistent with 'more than 100,000 m2' (2020) and with the operator's 110,000 m2. Calculated from reported figures; not a measurement.
